base.description: The finger duct as Tripp Lite ships SRCABLEDUCT1UHD, the cover fitted.

cover-off.description: The same duct with the cover taken off, the two walls of pockets and the channel between them open to lay a cable in. The cover comes with the duct, so this is an illustration and not a device type.

datasheet.title: Tripp Lite SRCABLEDUCT1UHD spec sheet (SmartRack 1U High Capacity Horizontal Cable Manager - Finger duct with dual-hinge cover)

description: Eaton Tripp Lite series SmartRack 1U high capacity horizontal cable manager, a finger duct with a dual-hinge cover. It is a black cold rolled steel channel on a back plate that bolts to the rack rails and stands 118 mm out of them. A wall along its top and one along its bottom each carry nine wide pockets. A cable bundle is laid through a pocket into the channel, and a cover across the front closes it. The cover ships fitted and lifts off.

gaps.note: the spec sheet gives the unit size twice and the two disagree on height and depth: 2.040 x 19.000 x 4.660 in (51.82 x 482.6 x 118.36 mm) and 4.45 x 48.26 x 12.26 cm (44.5 x 482.6 x 122.6). The inch figures are used. No drawing or manual settled it.

name: srcableduct1uhd

attrs.note: datasheet - material and colour (cold rolled steel with black finish), the mounting hardware (included) and compliance (RoHS; EIA/ECA-310-E) are the spec sheet's.

capacity.note: datasheet - the spec sheet states no cable capacity, fill or bend radius, though it calls the duct "high capacity". None is recorded and none is estimated; a gap says so.

chassis.note: datasheet - 482.6 x 51.82 x 118.36 (19.000 x 2.040 x 4.660 in), the spec sheet's inch figures. THE HEIGHT IS MORE THAN ONE RACK UNIT (44.45 mm) and the part is stated as 1U: the centimetre figure, 4.45 cm, is a unit exactly. The part states `ru: 1`.

color.note: estimated - "Color: Black" and "cold rolled steel with black finish" are the spec sheet's; the shade is this library's render of black steel, lifted from near-black so the part reads on the explorer's dark stage as well as on a white one.

cover.note: datasheet - the cover ships fitted (the spec sheet's title, highlights and package: "finger duct with dual-hinge cover"). It is drawn fitted in `base` and absent in `cover-off`, as a lid (`lid: true`). THE FORMAT HAS NO HINGE: the cover is one plate that lifts off, and how it swings on its two hinges is a gap.

ears.note: estimated - a rack-face part is its ears and what hangs off them, so the face is the 482.6 mm of the spec sheet's 19.000 in. No document draws the ears; they are the 25.4 mm at each end of the back plate, as the SRCABLEDUCT1U's drawing dimensions its own, with two slots each where an EIA-310 ear has them (8.8 mm in from the end, 32 mm apart; 12 x 6 mm as that drawing gives).

front.note: estimated - the cover, fitted: a front plate across the channel, as the SRCABLEDUCT1U's drawing draws its own and the spec sheet's photographs show a deep front plate. The two walls and the channel between them are drawn as the SRCABLEDUCT1U's drawing gives its own, 1.1 mm walls standing 1.1 mm in from the top and bottom, which leaves 47.42 mm clear. The `duct` guide is that channel over the 431.8 mm between the ears.

guides.note: estimated - NINE POCKETS A WALL, COUNTED ON THE MAKER'S PHOTOGRAPH. The main picture shows the duct from above and in front, a row of wide pockets between ten dividers along its top; the fingers are on the top wall and, as the maker's sister duct draws, the bottom is the top again (no picture of this part shows its underside). Nine pockets 34.0 mm wide on a 46.0 pitch, a 12.0 mm divider, are by eye on a perspective view. The pockets are closed at both ends, as the SRCABLEDUCT1U's slots are drawn, so no divider has a free tip. A cable is laid along the channel and passes between the walls through a pocket.

left.note: estimated - the side: the back plate, the two walls with the channel between them, and the cover's plate and lips over the front. The duct is open at both ends and a cable runs out of it there: nothing is built across the ends. The right is the same, turned round.

mount.note: estimated - `rack-face`, as the maker's SRCABLEDUCT1U (a drawing) and the FS 1U ducts: it bolts to the rail face at one rack unit and stands out of it, which the spec sheet says as "1U 19-inch horizontal cable manager". No document shows how far the back plate stands behind the ear plane, so `depth` is the overall 118.36 and the whole of it is taken as projecting.

rear.note: estimated - the back plate with its ears and their slots. No document shows the back of the part, and nothing else is drawn on it.

size-conflict.note: THE SPEC SHEET'S INCHES AND CENTIMETRES DISAGREE, AND NO OTHER MAKER DOCUMENT SETTLES IT. "Unit Dimensions (hwd / in.) 2.040 x 19.000 x 4.660" is 51.82 x 482.6 x 118.36 mm; "Unit Dimensions (hwd / cm) 4.45 x 48.26 x 12.26" is 44.5 x 482.6 x 122.6. The width agrees. 4.45 cm is exactly one rack unit (1.75 in) and 2.04 in is 5.18 cm; 12.26 cm is 4.83 in and 4.66 in is 11.84 cm. The inch figures are taken, as the sheet prints them first, and the centimetre ones are not used; the owner is asked to accept that. If the centimetre figures are the true ones the height is 44.45 and the depth 122.6.

sources.note: THE MAKER'S OWN DOCUMENT AND NOTHING ELSE. The SRCABLEDUCT1UHD spec sheet (assets.tripplite.com, 2 pages, © 2026 Eaton): three pictures, a description, features and a specification table. The submittal drawing at the address the SRCABLEDUCT1U's follows returns an XML error page, not a PDF; the Eaton SKU page was tried once (the .html and the skuPage .pdf export both fail at the connection with an HTTP/2 stream error, and a regional copy timed out), and the owner's manual the package includes could not be found by its address. So no dimension is drawn and every figure but the unit size is estimated. Nothing is copied from the pictures.

thickness.note: estimated - no document states the gauge; 1.1 mm is the SRCABLEDUCT1U's, a drawing of the same maker's 1U steel duct.

top.note: estimated - the plan, rear at y=0: the back 5.0 mm, the wall, and the cover's lip over the front 12.0 mm; the nine pockets run from 8.0 mm in front of the back to under the lip. The bottom is the same as the top.

weight.note: datasheet - 1.18 kg (2.6 lb), the spec sheet's Unit Weight.

guides.source: SRCABLEDUCT1UHD photograph: nine pockets counted; walls as the SRCABLEDUCT1U drawing; no dimension in the spec sheet
